incidents.name: BvaultsStrategy convertDustToEarned unprotected swap
incidents.notes: BvaultsStrategy.convertDustToEarned() is permissionless and swaps the strategy's holdings through PancakeSwap with no minimum-output check, so a flash-loan-skewed pool let the attacker capture the strategy's swap.
